rules.source: Approved v11.5 §4.6 and N07, centralized todo and existing authorized role lists from the current user instruction
rules.rule: Publish an order urgency marker and consume it only on the original authorized identity; promote only comparable existing ready rows.
rules.initialization: Read the effective published document or frozen preorder for the same resolved ID. Do not infer urgency from drafts, styles, PO text, routing names or deadlines.
rules.dateAndPermission: Project after original permission, state and scope selection. Existing operational priority, due dates, SLA calculations, paging, owners and entry actions stay in their original scopes.
rules.expectation: Published rush and converted order show the same red marker; an ordinary, hidden or overlapped unrelated order has no such marker and no fabricated due date.

rules.source: Approved v11.5 revised §4.7, §8.4/8.6 and the A4 landscape double-document sample
rules.rule: Print the exact authorized saved development sheet and a separately paginated customer feedback sheet when there is reliable feedback evidence.
rules.initialization: Reads existing publication and verified native round events. Original saved picture/measurement identities stay intact. Non-proven dispatch or return dates remain absent.
rules.dateAndPermission: Use exact source/round/version after existing read/attachment authority, with Beijing dates derived from actual trusted events. No read upgrade or visible price addition for board roles.
rules.expectation: Original and feedback print once on separately paginated A4 landscape. Different dispatch and return dates remain truthful; text-only and invalid original attachment cases stay explicit. New adopted A versus later B image authorization stays in C5.

rules.source: Approved v11.5 §4.2–4.5 and §8.4, revision-specific material detail and existing handover
rules.rule: Retain exact fabric and trim values, versioned supplier selection, trustworthy totals and original material occurrence scope.
rules.initialization: Existing saved historical supplier and material facts stay valid. Select only the bounded current supplier snapshot; unknown trim remains unknown. No arrival is ever manufactured.
rules.dateAndPermission: The designer can record planning readiness and a required expected date when explicitly missing. Original clerk and merchandiser authority controls physical occurrence, and protected prices keep the existing reader boundaries.
rules.expectation: Preserve the exact quantity x price and original decimals, material identities and other fields across a long sheet reload. The genuine preorder can retain its original handover on formal conversion.

rules.source: Approved v11.5 §4.1–4.5, updated existing separate upper/lower measurement templates and G2
rules.rule: Keep three existing create flows distinct, recover only a matching saved draft, and allow a scoped reversible-in-records draft discard without effective publication.
rules.initialization: Apply migration 0304 through the original manifests; preserve stored documents, original audit, old entries and linked sources. Missing clothing classification is explicit and dimensions optional, not a reason to reset saved row values.
rules.dateAndPermission: Original signed designer can discard own qualified ordinary draft under version and lock. Original effective publication, approval, replay and counters remain bound to the same acknowledged IDs, with no draft SLA start.
rules.expectation: Pure development, published/converted preorder and formal order are distinct. Retry recovers the exact source rather than allocating again. Long upper and pants sheets retain all size and material values, selected attachments and existing PO after reload.
